title: Implement the protected navigation shell
verify: Every protected page renders one shell with Home, Classes, Statistics, Profile, and Logout destinations from the server-resolved actor context.
Unauthenticated and revoked sessions remain denied; the shell does not implement logout or broaden role/scope behavior.
evidence_required: authentication-transport.md#browserapi-path RED: a protected page has no common navigation shell or trusts client role state; GREEN: route tests prove the shell is rendered only for the server-authenticated protected context with the five named destinations; artifact: .tasks/TASK-060-T3-FT-007-W28/ and .protocols/TASK-060-T3-FT-007-W28/.
purpose: Provide the reusable protected navigation shell without taking ownership of logout or role destinations.
success_outcome: Protected pages share one server-aware shell exposing the required navigation destinations while unauthenticated pages remain unchanged.
anti_goals: Do not implement session revocation or logout proof.
Do not read provider tables or decide Home/Classes scope in the layout.
Do not use study-calendar.db in tests.
constraints: Layout is a transport/presentation adapter over server-resolved actor context.
Logout behavior is verified by TASK-062, not inherited here.
Provider modules and the shared real database remain outside this task.
invariants: No client-supplied role or scope controls shell visibility.
The shell does not mutate account, session, class, attendance, or financial state.
Unauthenticated requests do not receive protected shell data.
verification_targets: authentication-transport.md#browserapi-path: protected shell route and actor-context matrix.
access-control.md#authority-and-scope: no client role/scope authority and no provider-table bypass.

stop_conditions: Stop if the shell requires a new session, role, or authorization contract.
Stop if layout code must read provider tables or implement Home/Classes business rules.
